title: TableMetadataCacheUsage
description: Table level detail on the usage of metadata caching. Only set for Metadata caching eligible tables referenced in the query.

unusedReason.description: Reason for not using metadata caching for the table.

staleness.description: Duration since last refresh as of this job for managed tables (indicates metadata cache staleness as seen by this job).

explanation.description: Free form human-readable reason metadata caching was unused for the job.
